neighborhoods.name: Laleham

property_mix.era: predominantly interwar and post-war suburban, with Victorian riverside properties
property_mix.notable: Strong riverside character (Thames and Colne); mix of affluent period homes and standard suburban semis. Significant conservation areas in central and riverside zones.

locksmith_relevant: Victorian and Edwardian riverside villas in Laleham often feature period locks and sash windows requiring specialist knowledge.
High proportion of interwar semis across Stanwell and Knowle Green means many older Yale and Chubb mechanisms still in use.
Modern Thorpe Lea riverside development and flat conversions create demand for contemporary UPVC and electronic access control systems.
